descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
This virtual reality application is a narrative-driven, introspective experience designed to immerse the player in a symbolic and emotional journey.

The experience begins in a familiar yet unsettling situation, but quickly shifts into a more abstract and surreal space where the boundaries between reality, memory, and awareness start to dissolve.

Rather than relying on explicit storytelling or dialogue, the experience communicates through atmosphere, visual symbolism, sound design, and pacing. Each scene is carefully crafted to evoke emotion and personal interpretation, allowing every player to connect with the experience in their own way.

The application places strong emphasis on presence, mood, and emotional flow rather than traditional gameplay mechanics. It is not intended to frighten or shock, but to invite reflection—on the passage of time, the memories that shape us, and moments when we are forced to look inward.

This experience is ideal for players who appreciate artistic, conceptual, and emotionally driven VR content, and who are looking for something beyond conventional gameplay.
